what: Electron plasma oscillations in the very local interstellar medium. Their frequency is the local electron plasma frequency, so the pitch measures density. PWS senses electric-field waves in the plasma, not sound; the audio is the wave signal played through a speaker (frequencies are already in the audio band).

relation.source: NRL Plasma Formulary (f_pe = 8.98e3 * n_e^1/2 Hz, n_e in cm^-3)

measurements.how: f_p from the tone 'near 2.1 kHz' (Univ. Iowa caption); n_e derived here with f_p=8.98 kHz*sqrt(n_e)
Gurnett et al. 2013, Science 341, 1489: oscillations near 2.6 kHz -> n_e ~0.08 cm^-3
Ocker et al. 2021, Nature Astronomy 5, 761: 'consistent with n_e ~0.11 cm^-3'
Ocker et al. 2021: mean VLISM density 0.12 cm^-3 used for rms(n_e)/n_e = 0.0041/0.12
Ocker et al. 2021: POE leading edge at 3.06 kHz; n_e derived here
Ocker et al. 2021: f_p rises to 3.15 kHz as the shock passes; n_e derived here
